svg.text: Security architecture: trust zones and controls
Each arrow crosses a boundary and each boundary has controls. If a control fails, the next zone assumes the request is hostile.
Tokens, OTPs, PINs, NRC numbers, full card data, API keys. Logs carry a request
Each service has its own database user. Admin tokens use a separate audience.
Production access needs approval and is logged.
Revoke all sessions in one call, rotate provider keys in under an hour, freeze all
payouts with one switch, keep audit logs for 7 years.
Part 10 · System diagrams · Mulungushi University, Zambia
